description: A stereo eight-band equaliser whose output is fed back into its own input, so the bands you boost ring and can be pushed into oscillating

params.text: Sets how much of the output is sent back into the input and with which polarity, -95 per cent to +95 per cent, with 0 leaving a plain equaliser
Cuts or boosts the band at 60Hz, a low shelf, -12dB to +12dB, and sets how much that region dominates the feedback loop
Cuts or boosts the band at 170Hz, -12dB to +12dB, and sets how much that region dominates the feedback loop
Cuts or boosts the band at 310Hz, -12dB to +12dB, and sets how much that region dominates the feedback loop
Cuts or boosts the band at 600Hz, -12dB to +12dB, and sets how much that region dominates the feedback loop
Cuts or boosts the band at 1kHz, -12dB to +12dB, and sets how much that region dominates the feedback loop
Cuts or boosts the band at 3kHz, -12dB to +12dB, and sets how much that region dominates the feedback loop
Cuts or boosts the band at 6kHz, -12dB to +12dB, and sets how much that region dominates the feedback loop
Cuts or boosts the band at 12kHz, a high shelf, -12dB to +12dB, and sets how much that region dominates the feedback loop

inputs.text: The right channel in, which takes a copy of the left when it has no cable

notes: the module has no CV inputs, so it is a hands-on module rather than one to automate
a soft limiter and a DC blocker hold the loop together, and neither is applied to the audible output, so what leaves the module is not limited
the white lamp shows the level of the output rather than the feedback setting, and the lamp beside a band shows the energy around that band
menu: Feedback EQ8 Options — a heading over the item under it
Reset All — returns all eight bands and the feedback amount to 0

inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic
